research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Li6PS5Cl argyrodite — REDUCED 13-atom fixture
purpose: Battery MVP known-borderline control (PRD §Scope) — recover high-conductivity potential while flagging disorder, moisture sensitivity, Li-metal interface, and oxidative-stability concerns.
notes: REDUCED FIXTURE — one formula unit Li6PS5Cl (13 atoms) on the F-43m argyrodite host (a = 9.859 Å). Ordered S/Cl positions (real argyrodite has S/Cl partial occupancy that drives disorder-dependent conductivity); SOD-disordered supercell loaded downstream when needed.
